title: GoThru Maps API Go & Photographer API Go Project Report

issues.display_title: Issue #63: Migrate API Collection from Postman to Bruno
issues.main_description_html:
Implementation — Migrate API Collection from Postman to Bruno

Status: Done
Depends on: postman-to-bruno-migration-task.md

Format

Collection uses Bruno's opencollection YAML format (not the older .bru
DSL). Root marker:

# api-collection/GoThru Maps/opencollection.yml
opencollection: 1.0.0
info:
  name: GoThru Maps
bundled: false
extensions:
  bruno:
    ignore:
      - node_modules
      - .git

Every folder gets a folder.yml with a seq (sidebar order) and, where the
whole folder shares auth, auth: inherit:

# v1 - photographers/folder.yml
info:
  name: v1 / photographers
  type: folder
  seq: 13
request:
  auth: inherit

Every request is its own <Request Name>.yml:

# v1 - photographers/Create Portfolio.yml
info:
  name: Create Portfolio
  type: http
  seq: 22
http:
  method: POST
  url: "{{base_url}}/v1/photographers/portfolio"
  auth: inherit
settings:
  encodeUrl: true
  timeout: 0
  followRedirects: true
  maxRedirects: 5
  forwardAuthorizationHeader: false

Structure

Folders under api-collection/GoThru Maps/ mirror the backend's route
groups: v1 - availability, v1 - cron, v1 - equipment, v1 - geodata,
v1 - maps, v1 - martin, v1 - moderation, v1 - pano, v1 - panorra,
v1 - photographers, v1 - queue, v1 - services, v1 - tour,
v2 - photographers, Photographers (dashboard) (with its own
equipment / portfolio / profile / review / availability /
services sub-folders), Photographers Frontend, and socket. A handful
of standalone utility requests sit at collection root (clear redis.yml).

Environments

api-collection/GoThru Maps/environments/, each file a name +
variables list of base_url / bearerToken. Built so far:

# environments/Live.yml
name: Live
variables:
  - name: base_url
    value: http://192.168.1.194:3008
  - name: bearerToken
    value: ""

One environment, Live, pointed at a LAN IP for on-device testing;
bearerToken left blank pending a real token.

Verification

  • Opened in Bruno desktop app: collection tree loads, folders match route
    groups, switching to Live environment resolves {{base_url}} in request
    URLs.
  • No automated check — this is a testing-tool artifact, not shipped code.

Type: Tooling / DX

Requirement

Team's API testing collection for this backend lives in Postman. Move it to
Bruno (api-collection/GoThru Maps), a git-friendly, file-based collection
format, so the collection can be versioned and reviewed alongside the code
instead of living in a separate cloud workspace.

Acceptance criteria

  • Every route group in the backend has a matching Bruno folder under
    api-collection/GoThru Maps (e.g. v1 - photographers, v1 - equipment,
    v2 - photographers, Photographers (dashboard), socket).
  • Each request uses {{base_url}} for the host, not a hardcoded URL, so
    switching environments doesn't require editing every request.
  • Auth is centralized: folders and requests set auth: inherit instead of
    each request carrying its own bearer token.
  • An environment file exists per target the team actually hits: local
    machine, LAN/local-network device testing, deployed dev, and live —
    each with a real base_url and its own bearerToken.

Out of scope

  • Migrating Postman test scripts / pre-request scripts.
  • Postman → Bruno automated conversion tooling — collection is rebuilt by
    hand per route group, not run through a converter.
